question: Vikramaditya VI, whose court poet Bilhan wrote his biography, was the ruler of the ________ dynasty.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Chalukya.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] Important Points__**

__
 
• **Vikramaditya VI**, whose court poet Bilhan wrote his biography, was the ruler of the Chalukya dynasty.

 
• The Chalukya dynasty was established by Pulakeshin I in 543.
 
• Pulakeshin I took Vatapi (modern Badami in Bagalkot district, Karnataka) under his control and made it his capital.
 
• Pulakeshin I and his descendants are referred to as "Chalukyas of Badami".
 
• The earliest dynasty, known as the "Badami Chalukyas", ruled from Vatapi (modern Badami) from the middle of the 6th century. 
 
• **Bilhana **was a Sanskrit writer and a well-known Kashmiri poet.
 
 
• He was born in Kavi Bilhana in the middle of the 11th century.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **The Pallava Dynasty **existed from 275 CE to 897 CE.
 
• The Pallava Dynasty was a ruling portion of southern India.
 
 
• The capital of the Pallava Dynasty was Kanchipuram.
 
• Pallavas are most noted for their patronage of architecture and they have established the foundations of medieval South Indian architecture. 
 
 
 
• Dantidurga was the founder of the Rashtrakutas dynasty.
 
 
• He is said to have conquered Kalinga, Kosala, Kanchi, Srisril, Malava, Lata, etc., and occupied Maharashtra by defeating Chalukya King Kirtivarma.
 
• Krishna I was the son and successor of Dantidurga.
 
• He conquered the territories that were still under the Chalukyas.
